Winter event on {wiki:Percht Island}, reached by a boat near the port of Svargrond. You gather three percht parts to make a disguise, enter the frozen hall and thaw {creature:The Percht Queen} with bonfires and Warm Fires before killing her. You get the Percht Raider outfit (and addons in later years), access to the sleigh mounts and, at the end of the event, all worlds receive a week of double respawn and regeneration.
The Percht Queen is awakening. Do you have the courage to withstand the deadly cold coming from her chambers and stop her from creating an endless winter?
Boat to Percht Island, Svargrond port
Recommended level 100 (for the queen fight, a team of level ~50 is enough).
Only during the event: from 22 December (server save) to 10 January.

{wiki:Percht Raider Outfits|Percht Raider Outfit} (1st victory), 1st addon (2 years of participation), 2nd addon + achievement **Raider in the Dark** (3 years)
Sleigh mounts {wiki:Dark Percht Sleigh}, {wiki:Bright Percht Sleigh} and {wiki:Cold Percht Sleigh} (with {item:Percht Skull|Percht Skulls})

Percht sleigh mounts (Dark, Bright and Cold Percht Sleigh)
After taking part in the event once; with 2 and 3 participations you can upgrade them to the next variants.
You pay with {item:Percht Skull|Percht Skulls}: 3 for the first sleighs and 1 per mount for each upgrade.
When you arrive on the island, talk to {npc:Frosty}, the friendly snowman: he explains the place and its inhabitants.
The queen fight is very easy and almost without risk of dying: you can go with up to 5 players, once every 20 hours.
Everyone has to deal **elemental damage** to the queen to receive loot.
Take the boat to **Svargrond** in Carlin, Thais or Venore: say {key:hi}, {key:svargrond}, {key:yes} to the captain. You arrive at {npc:Captain Breezelda}'s boat, in the Svargrond harbour.
From 22 December a small boat appears near the **Svargrond** harbour. Use it to travel to {wiki:Percht Island}.
The boat near the Svargrond harbour
On the island, talk to {npc:Frosty}, who tells you more about the place and its inhabitants.
To face the queen you need three items: 1 pair of {item:Twig Arms}, 1 {item:Broken Bell} and 1 pair of {item:Percht Horns}. The Twig Arms are the most work.
Look for a {item:Barrel Filled with Hammers} and use it to take out a {item:Soft Hammer}.

Use the hammer on a {creature:Bonny Bunny}: it faints and becomes a {creature:Stunned Bunny}. Use the stunned rabbit. If it fails, *"As soon as you reach out for the stunned rabbit it comes to its senses and flees."* appears; if it works, the message ends with *"It seems to have left something!"*. Repeat until you succeed and pick up the {item:Frozen Carrot}.
Pick up {item:Snowball|Snowballs} from the {item:Snow Heap|snow heaps} on the island (they are unlimited). Put one on the ground and use another on it to make a {item:Large Snowball}.
Use the {item:Frozen Carrot} on the {item:Large Snowball}: an {creature:Animated Snowman} appears. Kill it. Repeat until you loot a pair of {item:Twig Arms}.

You can only create a snowman once every **5 minutes** and only on Percht Island ("You're still exhausted from building your previous snowman." / "Nothing happens."). This step can also fail: "A gust of wind blows your snowman away. Unlucky!".
Kill {creature:Percht|Perchts} and {creature:Schiach|Schiachs} all over the island until you have 1 {item:Broken Bell} and 1 pair of {item:Percht Horns}.
4. Getting to the Percht Queen's throne
With the 3 items, go down here and then go down again at the second spot.
Use one of the three items on another to make a percht disguise. You get the message *"You managed to create a convincing disguise by combining various remains from the percht."*.
The disguise gives you access to the lever room. Until you fight the queen (successfully or not), you don't need a new disguise.
Disguised, walk **south-west** and enter the teleport. In the room, pull the lever to start the fight (up to 5 players, once every 20 hours).
The queen starts frozen. You have to throw 4 {creature:Warm Fire|Warm Fires} at her to thaw her, and only then can you kill her.
After pulling the lever you end up in a small room with a {item:Warm Bonfire} and a {item:Vortex of Nature}. Use the bonfire: a {item:Percht Warding Torch} appears in front of it. Pick it up.
Room with the bonfire and the vortex
Step on the vortex: you turn into a {creature:Leaf Golem}.

Go down and quickly head to the other side of the dungeon. **Do not go north.** When you get near the wall, a {item:Rush Wood} (tree) appears. Use it 5 times; each time a {item:Branch (Quest)|branch} drops in front of it. Pick them all up.
Go **south**, to the {item:Burn Out Bonfire}. If it isn't lit, use the torch on it so it becomes a {item:Smoldering Bonfire}. Then use the branches on the bonfire.
Repeat until a Warm Fire appears

Once the branches are used up, go back to the **west** side, turn into a Leaf Golem again and repeat the process until the bonfire becomes a {item:Blazing Bonfire} and a {creature:Warm Fire} appears. You need **20 branches** in total.
When the Warm Fire appears, the bonfire goes out: use the torch on it again and then use the bonfire. You start burning (*Burning Man* form).
The torch only lasts 40 seconds: get a new one whenever you need.
Take the Warm Fire to the queen

Lure the Warm Fire **north**. The {creature:Percht Minion|Percht Minions} try to kill it, and there are ice rays coming from the north of the room: avoid them. When it arrives, the Warm Fire explodes and damages {creature:The Percht Queen}. Repeat the whole process until she thaws (**4 Warm Fires**) and then kill her.
Never go to the north of the room if you are not transformed into a Burning Man: you freeze immediately and are teleported out of the fight, with no way to come back.

- If you don't pass near the bonfire in the west every few minutes, you get cold (*"You are cold."*). If you see this message, quickly go west and get close to the bonfire.
- To receive loot you have to deal **elemental damage** to the queen. Knights should use weapons with elemental damage or runes such as the {item:Great Fireball Rune}; even a little damage is enough.

You can use creatures that don't walk on fire to distract the Percht Minions: two between the stairs and the centre are enough. Paladins and Knights can do it with {item:Animate Dead Rune|Animate Dead Runes} (bring a corpse with you).
Percht Raider Outfit (on the first victory)
Leave the dungeon and Percht Island

After the fight, go back to the island's surface the same way you came down (the two descent points). To go back to Svargrond, return to the place where the boat dropped you on the island; the sources describe no other way back. In Svargrond, {npc:Captain Breezelda} takes you to Carlin, Thais or Venore ({key:hi}, name of the city, {key:yes}).

You receive the {wiki:Percht Raider Outfits|Percht Raider} outfit the first time you defeat the queen. The 1st addon comes after you take part in the event 2 times (2 years) and the 2nd addon, with the achievement **Raider in the Dark**, after you take part 3 times (3 years).
After taking part once you can hand in 3 {item:Percht Skull|Percht Skulls} to receive the sleighs. With more participations you can upgrade them by handing in 1 Percht Skull per mount.
At the end of the event (server save on 10 January), all worlds receive one week of double respawn and double mana and health regeneration. It is not possible to "fail" the event.
